AI Notes.value: Portrait and fine art photographer, b. 1995 Victorville CA, Parsons School of Design grad. Freelance with dual commercial and fine art representation: commercial via SN37 Agency and Giant Artists; fine art via Sarah Hasted Gallery (New York). Senior freelance level, roughly 10+ years active; trajectory has been rapid ascent from editorial into major commercial and gallery work. Clients include Vogue, Vanity Fair, The New York Times, GQ, Apple, Nike, Ralph Lauren, Thom Browne, Valentino, Lancome, Spotify, Samsung, and more. Fine art prints in permanent collections at LACMA and the Detroit Institute of Arts. Published monograph "What's My Name" (Prestel, 2024). Co-founder of See In Black, a collective supporting Black photographers.
